title: First Date
description:
You finally got the courage to ask the girl of your dreams on a first date. Wanting to give her something truly meaningful... something to express a feeling words can't.

Later that evening, you saw the new town board about a new discovered lake, and without hesitation you took the highway, away from your quiet hometown in search for a meaningful gift, something precious enough to match her eyes.

Explore the peaceful lake hidden in the deep forest, blooming colorful flowers, and the beauty of nature.

Discover, explore, collect, and discover 111 different flowers as you create a beautiful bouquet filled with your love and appreciation. Every flower has a story, and every choice brings you closer to creating the perfect first date memory.
description_short: Gathering the courage to ask the girl of my dreams on a first date, I set out to find a gift special enough for her, express a feeling that words can't. Explore a peaceful lake filled with nature, discover 111 unique flowers, and create a bouquet to express your love and create a first date memory.
